target.statement: LoCa-0.95 achieves 71.08% top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-100 with ResNet56 teacher and ResNet20 student, +0.42 over vanilla KD (70.66%)

compute.basis: Paper reports ~2 hours on 1 A100 GPU for CIFAR-100 distillation (240 epochs); on an 8-core CPU this is roughly 10x slower, i.e. ~20 hours, and the LoCa method must be reimplemented from scratch since no code is released.

blockers: No code released (no repository link in paper)
Requires reimplementing LoCa calibration and full KD training pipeline from scratch
240-epoch training on CPU is slow (~20h), exceeding a few-hour budget
title: LoCa: Logit Calibration for Knowledge Distillation
